answer: The Identity Weighted Voting (IWV) mechanism resists Sybil attacks by assigning weights to identities based on their participation history, with inactive identities slowly losing weight over time, akin to an ember fading. This discourages attackers from creating new identities, as each new one would need to prove its own credibility, similar to a glacier forming a new peak. As a result, attackers must constantly wander between identities to maintain their influence, incurring significant overhead and increasing the likelihood of detection.
